Body_activate_inference_policy_api_admin.description:
The activate-policy body. The name is FastAPI's generated `Body_*` component name; keeping it
verbatim is what lets the lock comparison be a name-for-name comparison.

ChatCompletionRequest.description: `POST /api/chat/completions` request — OpenAI-compatible, narrowed where the router validates.

oneOf.description:
vLLM chat-template kwargs (e.g. `{"enable_thinking": false}`). A provider whose catalog
entry sets `force_chat_template_kwargs` overrides `enable_thinking`; other keys pass through.

max_tokens.description: Also accepted as `max_completion_tokens` (the alias pydantic-ai and openai-python send).

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether the model may answer with several tool calls at once; forwarded verbatim.

ChatMessage.description: One message in the prompt or the model's answer.

role.description: The role of a message; the capture makes it an enum, so an unknown role is a 422.

HTTPValidationError.description: FastAPI's 422 envelope. The names are FastAPI's: clients already parse them.

HealthResponse.description: `GET /health` — `HealthResponse.status` defaults to `ok` and is not required.

JsonSchemaSpec.description: A named JSON Schema for guided output.

LivenessResponse.description: `GET /health/live` — `LivenessResponse.alive` defaults to `true` and is not required.

ModelObject.description: One routable model id, pinned to the provider(s) that serve it.

PatchInvocationLogRequest.description: `PATCH /api/replay/invocation-log/*` request — only the supplied fields change.

PromptCanaryState.description: The canary window for one worker.

ProviderModelObject.description: One model id a provider serves.

ProviderObject.description: One catalog provider as a UI sees it.

ToolCall.description: A tool call the model emitted.

ToolCallFunction.description: The function a tool call names and its serialized arguments.

ToolFunctionSpec.description: The declared function, its description and its JSON Schema parameters.

Usage.description: Token usage, including the classes the estate's metering needs beyond OpenAI's three.

WhoamiResponse.description: `GET /api/whoami` — what the licence server says about the caller's token.
